name: base_r1_b
setup: set -e; pip install -q numpy tokenizers matplotlib transformers==4.51.3; T=/opt/babylm/ruler_tools_c09ef37ac16bbe0a9f3ab9def66ad000ea40cef5; mkdir -p $T; gsutil -q cp "$RULER_TOOLS_URI" /tmp/rt.tgz; tar -xzf /tmp/rt.tgz -C $T; python -m babylm.data.prepare --download; $T/babylm/eval/setup.sh /opt/babylm; if [ -n "${R1_ARGS:-}" ]; then python -m babylm.configs.make_base_jobs --r1 $R1_ARGS; fi; cp babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json _logs/jobs_base_r1_S.used.json

jobs.name: base_r1_b
jobs.cmd:
nvidia-cuda-mps-control -d && echo '[pack] MPS on'; python - <<'PYB' > _logs/pack_cmds.txt
import json,shlex
j=[x for x in json.load(open('babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json'))['jobs'] if x['name']!='base_gpu_smoke_levers'][0]
a=[str(x) for x in j['args']]
i=a.index('--out') if '--out' in a else None
a=[x for k,x in enumerate(a) if i is None or k not in (i,i+1)]
a=[x for x in a if x not in ('--save',)]
print(' '.join(shlex.quote(x) for x in a))
PYB
for k in 1 2 3; do for i in $(seq 1 $k); do timeout 300 python -m babylm.harness.train $(cat _logs/pack_cmds.txt) --device cuda --out /tmp/pack_${k}_$i > _logs/pack_${k}_$i.log 2>&1 & done; wait; python - $k <<'PYS'
import re,sys,statistics as s
k=int(sys.argv[1]); tot=0
for i in range(1,k+1):
    v=[float(x.replace(',','')) for x in re.findall(r'([0-9,]+) tok/s',open(f'_logs/pack_{k}_{i}.log').read())][-5:]
    m=s.median(v) if v else 0; tot+=m; print(f'[pack] k={k} copy={i} tok/s={m:,.0f} n={len(v)}')
print(f'[pack] k={k} aggregate tok/s={tot:,.0f}')
PYS
done; echo quit | nvidia-cuda-mps-control; rm -rf /tmp/pack_*; NAMES=$(python -c "import json,os; n=[x['name'] for x in json.load(open('babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json'))['jobs'] if x['name']!='base_gpu_smoke_levers']; h=(len(n)+1)//2; print(' '.join(n[:h] if os.environ['PART']=='A' else n[h:]))"); echo "[r1] part $PART: $NAMES"; python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json --only base_gpu_smoke_levers --device cuda; SKIP=; [ -f babylm/runs/base_gpu_smoke_levers/result.json ] || { echo '[r1] smoke failed: skipping mntp cells'; SKIP='mntp'; }; for n in $NAMES; do if [ -n "$SKIP" ] && echo $n | grep -qE "$SKIP"; then echo "[r1] skip $n"; continue; fi; python -m babylm.harness.run_jobs babylm/configs/jobs_base_r1_S.json --only $n --device cuda || echo "[r1] train $n failed"; [ -f babylm/runs/$n/result.json ] && { bash babylm/harness/score_trial.sh babylm/runs/$n /opt/babylm || echo "[r1] score $n failed"; }; done
